source.title: Valley Metro Bus Schedule (GTFS static)
source.producer: Valley Metro, published by City of Phoenix Open Data

definitions.dayType: weekday / saturday / sunday, extracted SEPARATELY. Weekend ridership must never be paired with a weekday timetable, and Saturday and Sunday are not interchangeable in this feed.
definitions.servicePattern: The MOST FREQUENT set of active service_ids across the dates of that day type (modal). Not the date with the most trips: that selects an outlier and calls it typical.
definitions.byRoute: Route name -> sorted scheduled departure MINUTES PAST THE START OF THE SERVICE DAY. Values >= 1440 are genuine GTFS times of 24:00 or later and denote the small hours still belonging to this service day; they are NOT wrapped here. Actual times, not counts: a headway distribution cannot be recovered from departures-per-hour.
definitions.departure: One stop_times row at the stop, on a trip in the chosen service pattern, excluding the trip's final stop (nobody waits there to board). Duplicate minutes within a route are collapsed: two trips scheduled to the same minute are one boarding opportunity.
definitions.hourlyDepartures: Convenience roll-up onto the 24 CLOCK hours (minute mod 1440) for coverage and demand-shape checks only. Nothing computes a waiting time from it.
definitions.departuresAfterMidnight: How many departures of this stop and day type sit at or past 24:00. Reported so the service-day projection applied downstream is visible rather than silent.

weekday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

saturday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

sunday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

definitions.caveat: Scheduled service, not observed service. Cancellations, detours, bunching and real-time deviation are not represented.
